plan.summary: Add a quick comparison table for the Codex, Deep Agents, and Claude example configurations.
requirements: Update plugins/nemo-agents/examples/nemo-agent-config/README.md with a compact table linking agent-codex.yaml, agent-deepagents.yaml, and agent-claude.yaml.
For each example, document its default harness, configured model provider/name, and whether MCP servers are configured, using the checked-out YAML as evidence.
Preserve existing instructions and describe configured values without claiming model availability or runtime compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: The table has one row per requested example with working relative links.
Every reported value matches the corresponding YAML file.
Only the example README changes; no credentials or machine-specific paths are introduced.

tasks.description: Read the three example configurations and existing README, then add or update the comparison table without duplicating existing content.
acceptance_criteria: The comparison is concise and grounded in the YAML files.

validation.scenario: Compare every table row with the source YAML and verify relative link targets exist.
validation.expected_outcome: All values and file links match the checkout.

validation.scenario: Inspect changed paths and run git diff --check.
validation.expected_outcome: Only the requested README changes and the whitespace check passes.

constraints: Documentation only; do not change implementation or publish a branch or PR.
